ChangeKind.description: How an Entry differs between the two sides of a Comparison.

oneOf.description: Only the new side has the Entry.
Only the old side has the Entry.
Both sides have the Entry, with a different uncompressed size or CRC-32C.

DirectoryCounts.description: The counts of the changed Entries below one top-level directory.

added.description: Entries only the new side has.

changed.description: Entries with a different uncompressed size or CRC-32C.

directory.description:
The top-level directory as the first changed Entry below it spells it; empty for Entries
at the root.

removed.description: Entries only the old side has.

EntryChangeReport.description: One added, removed or changed Entry.

new.description: The Entry on the new side, absent when it was removed.

old.description: The Entry on the old side, absent when it was added.

path.description: The Entry path as the new side stores it, or the old side for a removed Entry.

EntryCounts.description: The number of Entries per change kind.

added.description: Entries only the new side has.

changed.description: Entries with a different uncompressed size or CRC-32C.

removed.description: Entries only the old side has.

EntryLevel.description: The Entries added, removed and changed.

changes.description: Every added, removed or changed Entry, ordered by path ignoring case and separator kind.

counts.description: The number of Entries per change kind.

directories.description: The counts per top-level directory, ordered by directory ignoring case.

EntryState.description: What the central directory says about one side of an Entry.

crc32c.description: The CRC-32C of the uncompressed data.

Level.description: One level a Comparison works on.

oneOf.description: Entries added, removed or changed, from the central directories.

archive.description: The path the Archive was opened from.

build.description: The Build from the Channel's build manifest, `null` when it is unknown.

change_number.description: The Perforce change number the Build was made from.

channel.description: The Channel: the name of the folder holding the Archive, `null` when there is none.

Sources.description: The two Archives of a Comparison.

new.description: The Archive the changes lead to.

old.description: The Archive the changes start from.

description: The JSON report of a Comparison between an old and a new Archive.

entries.description: The Entry level, present when it was compared.

filter.description: The Filter that selected the Entries on both sides, `null` when every Entry was compared.

format_version.description: The version of the report shape.

title: P4K-Extractor Comparison report
